title: I am's map tweak
description: This texture pack modifies the boring minecraft map into a slightly tweaked version
body:
🗺️ I am’s Map Tweak

Version: 1.20+ | Resolution: 16x16

Give your world a fresh new look with I am’s Map Tweak!
This texture pack lightly reworks Minecraft’s visuals to make them feel smoother, more natural, and easier on the eyes—perfect for builders, explorers, and survival players alike.

✨ Features:

Polished, vanilla-like textures with improved color balance

Sharper maps and clearer terrain details for better navigation

Subtle realism while keeping the classic Minecraft charm

Fully optimized for performance and multiplayer

Crafted for those who love the vanilla feel—just a little better.
